detailed_description:
The target video maintains the original realistic documentary style and natural overcast daylight. The shot size is a medium shot throughout, framing from approximately the upper thighs or knees up to the top of the head, capturing the full upper body, both hands, and the measuring cup. The camera begins at a 45-degree angle to <Subject 1>'s right side — the side of his right hand, which does not hold the cup and performs the sprinkling action — shooting his right profile, then slowly arcs leftward around the man to a front view, completing the transition by approximately 00:05, after which it remains fixed in front medium shot.
[Shot 1] The scene opens at the outdoor fish farm. The camera is positioned at <Subject 1>'s right 45-degree side, capturing his right profile in medium shot. <Subject 1> (S1), the middle-aged man with short black hair in a dark grey T-shirt and olive-green waterproof waders, stands facing toward the left side of the frame — his original front direction. His right cheek, the line of his nose, and the contour of his right shoulder are visible; his right hand, closer to the camera, is free. In the background, the large green pond stretches at a diagonal from this side angle, with rural houses and trees along the far bank; the concrete rearing tank with green algae and water hyacinth runs along the foreground, its red-brick edge visible. <Subject 4>, the white flat board with two red bricks, sits on the brick edge in front of <Subject 1> toward the left side of the frame, seen in three-quarter view. The simple wooden shed frame is visible in the right background. <Subject 1> (S1) holds <Subject 3>, the stainless steel measuring cup filled with brown pellet feed, in his left hand — the hand farther from the camera — while his right hand reaches into the cup, stirring and grasping the feed. He looks down at the cup. As he performs this opening action, the camera begins its slow leftward arc, gradually rotating from right profile toward front view.
At approximately 00:03.000, the camera has arced to roughly a 20-degree angle, between side and front. <Subject 1> (S1) shifts his right hand to also hold the cup, now cradling <Subject 3> with both hands at his waist, continuing to look down. Both hands and the cup are clearly visible in the medium framing.
At approximately 00:05.000, the camera completes its arc and arrives directly in front of <Subject 1>, now in front medium shot. At this same moment, <Subject 1> (S1) lifts his head and faces the camera directly, still holding <Subject 3> with both hands. The background now shows the pond directly behind him, <Subject 4> the white board and bricks visible on the tank edge to his right (frame right), and the shed frame on the left.
At 00:06.000, from the front medium-shot position, <Subject 1> (S1) looks down again and raises his right hand, palm up with fingers slightly spread, in a sprinkling gesture above <Subject 3> while his left hand holds the cup. His right hand and its pinching-and-releasing finger motion are clearly visible from the front. He maintains this action through the remaining seconds, his gaze directed downward. As he performs the hand movement, he speaks in a steady, natural male voice, <d>[Chinese] 其实慢养，养的是品质。</d> His mouth moves naturally. The camera remains fixed in front medium shot from 00:05 to the end. All environmental elements, props, action timing, and dialogue are identical to the reference.

overall_soundscape:
Outdoor fish-farm ambience continues throughout, identical to <Video 1>: gentle pond atmosphere, soft water ripples, light wind, and distant rural background noise. The subtle sound of feed being stirred and sprinkled is audible, followed by <Subject 1> (S1)'s clear spoken line.

The camera holds steady with only a barely perceptible handheld breathing motion, keeping <Subject 1> centered in the frame throughout; no cuts occur within the 8-second duration.

【参考素材说明】
@图片 1：人物与场景参考（锁定男子的体型气质、短发造型、灰色 T 恤与深色背带裤穿着、湖区道路环境、户外自然光、竖屏构图）
@音频 1：口播台词与语气参考（锁定音频中的口播内容、语速节奏、诚恳自然的讲述语气.
【核心创意】
10 秒，9:16 竖屏，乡村纪实口播短视频风格。参考 @图片 1 中的男子在湖区道路场景中，一边缓慢向前走，一边按照 @音频 1 的内容进行自然口播。镜头以中景和近景为主，最大景别为中景，不使用远景、大全景、中全景，画面真实朴素，突出养殖户在地介绍产品的可信感。
【画面过程描述】
Shot 1（0-3s）— 男子开场走向镜头
景别：中景
场景：参考 @图片 1 的湖区道路，两侧有水塘、绿植和远处乡村标识，自然日光
主体：参考 @图片 1 的男子，灰色 T 恤、深色背带裤，形象朴素真实
运镜：手持跟拍，轻微稳定前推
动作：男子从道路远处缓慢向镜头走来，步伐自然，表情诚恳
台词：男子按照 @音频 1 内容说.

【整体要求补充】
▍画面质感
乡村纪实短视频质感，自然光，真实湖区道路环境，保留 @图片 1 中的男子穿着与户外朴素气质
▍口播要求
口播台词以 @音频 1 内容为准，语速、停顿和语气参考 @音频 1
男子口播自然可信，像当地养殖户介绍家乡产品，避免夸张广告腔
▍景别控制
最大景别尺度为中景，不使用远景、大全景、中全景
▍禁止项
画面禁止出现字幕、文字、水印、logo
禁止改变人物核心造型、服装和湖区道路场景属性
【不想要】
画面内不出现任何文字、字幕
不出现远景、大全景、中全景
无过度美颜、无虚假广告感
无剧烈镜头晃动
非叙事性音乐：N/A
